{{Top|leg}}
'''Assault drones''' were a type of [[Drone/Legends|drone]]. [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88B]] kept four assault drones in the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] of the ''[[IG-2000/Legends|IG-2000]]''. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] used the assault drones as advance [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] while boarding enemy [[Starship/Legends|starships]] when his quarry preferred to fight rather than surrender.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
